text: DREAM: inside the black shadow there is a ring of separate bright dots (not a continuous photon ring) plus a bright vertical smear on the left inner edge of the shadow (~x=520,y=340-390). Looks like sampling holes rather than physics. Present at tick 456 and 732.

DREAM pacing: the dream has only 3 subtitle lines; the first at tick 144, then ~22 s of silence, then 'The black is spreading...' at tick 1501, '(Nothing happened.)' at tick 1641 and the scene cuts to CUTSCENE at tick 1683 -- the last line is on screen ~0.7 s game time, too short to read (I never saw it on screen; shot at 1641 still showed the previous line).

Quarters: after clicking the game and looking down (pt look 0 250) the crosshair dot sits on the desk right beside the datapad, yet the target brackets jump up onto the porthole (top-left of screen, well off-crosshair) and the prompt still says 'E Look out of the porthole'. The datapad (bearing +0.2, 2.1 m) cannot be targeted. Expected the prompt to follow what the crosshair is on.

Quarters, facing the desk (yaw -26.4, datapad bearing +0, 1.3 m): crosshair dot sits squarely on the datapad but no use prompt appears, and pressing E does nothing (just re-plays a porthole line earlier). Controls hint lists 'the datapad' as usable with E. Could not read the datapad at all.

Probe console panel: the top-right hint 'Esc or Q to step back' runs underneath the hamburger menu button (the 'k' of 'back' touches/overlaps the button at x~1228). Also the panel took ~3 s wall time to slide in after pressing E (first shot after E showed only the zoomed console with no panel).

Probe console after launch: the slide-in panel covers the right half of the in-world console screen, so its caption 'BEACON K-1 · as seen from the...' and the bottom readout 'its cl...' are cut off. The two views (in-world screen and panel) duplicate each other but neither is fully readable together.

Prediction question 'Ping 7 arrived late. Log a prediction: when will ping 9 arrive?' popped up (timed, with a shrinking bar) while I was reading the panel. Pressed 2; the dialog vanished with no confirmation of what I picked or that it was logged (no subtitle, no panel line, no 'choice' event).

Probe console, ~tick 11430: status line reads 'Frozen at the horizon and too red to see by eye. An infrared telescope still catches it, barely.' while the same panel says APPEARS AT 3.22-3.30 rs and REDSHIFT 1+z 1.9 (brightness 7%). Its image is plainly at ~3 rs on the map, not at the horizon, and 1+z of 1.9 is not 'too red to see' -- the text runs ahead of the numbers shown beside it.

In-world probe console readout uses raw JS exponent format '1+z 8.80e+3' (tick ~13160) but a few seconds later the same field shows '1+z 7.1x10^6' in proper superscript notation -- inconsistent number formatting; 'e+3' looks like a bug to a player.
